tool.name: NYCServers
tool.description: NYCServers sells managed Windows VPS hosting for MetaTrader, cTrader, NinjaTrader and similar software. Locations include New York, London, Tokyo, Singapore, Hong Kong and Dublin.
features: Pre-installed brokers and platforms from an order form
Windows Server 2022 or Ubuntu 24.04, with a dedicated IP
A browser control panel for restarts and software installs
Yearly billing shown at a lower monthly rate than month to month

plans.name: Basic
plans.detail: Or $16.67/mo billed at $200 per year. 2 cores, 2 GB RAM, 60 GB. Suggested for 1 to 2 accounts.

plans.name: Standard
plans.detail: Or $26.67/mo billed at $320 per year. 2 cores, 4 GB RAM, 70 GB. Suggested for 3 to 6 accounts.

plans.name: Professional
plans.detail: Or $40/mo billed at $480 per year. 4 cores, 8 GB RAM, 100 GB. Suggested for 7 to 8 accounts.

plans.name: Dedicated
plans.detail: Or $109.38/mo in the first year ($1,312.50 billed yearly). The page says renewal is $1,750 per year. 16 GB RAM, 250 GB. Suggested for up to 25 accounts.

tool.pricing_note: Prices from the official Forex VPS page on 11 Oct 2026.
